new_statement: Because R=U union V is nonempty, e_R is a nonzero coordinate projection of C^m and ||e_R||=1. The two-sided norm bounds in def-extended-delta-inclusion give (1-t)||e_R|| <= ||w(e_R)|| <= (1+t)||e_R||. Since P_R=w(e_R), it follows that 1-t <= ||P_R|| <= 1+t and therefore | ||P_R||-1 | <= t <= t+epsilon_A. The parent node has already established that P_R is a t-projection. By the registered def-delta-projection, a t-projection is nonvanishing when the second norm alternative | ||P_R||-1 | <= O(t+epsilon_A) holds. The displayed bound proves that alternative with the explicit universal O-constant C=1, since | ||P_R||-1 | <= 1*(t+epsilon_A). Hence P_R is nonvanishing in precisely the sense required by lem-maincb-nested-corner-dimension-transport.
